advisories.note: The Subject writes 'Fixture file remains at `docs/coop/artifacts/fixtures/g21.v22/` with no platform subdirectory.' The claim is true of live bytes -- the directory holds exactly one file, G21.cc5.truncated-body.bin at 0444, and carries no platform subdirectory -- so nothing rejects. But 'remains' is the verb this lineage reserves for frozen predecessors, and it is used that way five times in the same paragraph ('Frozen leftover-join.v28 of G21 remains current G21 leftover remasurement', and so on). `fixtures/g21.v22/` is untracked and first exists in this cycle; it has no predecessor standing to remain in. D-350's Subject used the neutral 'live under `docs/coop/artifacts/fixtures/g21.v21/`' for the same structural slot. A later successor drafting a first-authoring Subject would carry less ambiguity with 'lives at' or 'is at'. This is drafting work, not a rejecting finding, and it is not a bar to recording.

observations: The authored fixture directory is `fixtures/g21.v22/` while the corpus artifact is g21-fixture-corpus.v26, and the same Subject paragraph separately says 'Frozen g21-fixture-corpus.v22, g21-fixture-corpus.v23, and g21-fixture-corpus.v24 stay unrecorded'. The token `g21.v22` and the token `g21-fixture-corpus.v22` therefore both appear in one paragraph naming different objects. The draft keeps them lexically distinct and never abbreviates either, and the directory name is the subject's own authoredCatalog path rather than a draft invention, so nothing is collapsed. It is a naming adjacency worth watching in later entries of this lineage, where the fixture-directory counter and the corpus counter have now diverged by four.

The Decision-type line summarises the cycle as 'independent dual ACCEPT of `g21-fixture-corpus.v26.json` (0 blockers, 0 SHOULD-FIX)'. Claude Stage A has no blockers field at all; Codex carries blockerCount as the number 0. The summary phrase is therefore a cycle-level characterisation, not a per-reviewer shape claim, and the observation-disposition table immediately below states 'no blockers field' for Claude and 'blockerCount is the number 0' for Codex. The precise shapes are preserved where they are load-bearing, so no flattening occurs.

The draft recites fourteen distinct Codex shape facts and eleven distinct Claude shape facts, matching the dispatched enumerations member for member. Notably it carries 'findingIdentifiersInvented is false', which the D-350 entry's Codex row omitted. The shape recitation has grown rather than eroded across this lineage.

The payload is the sharpest available witness of its class. The bytes are exactly 00 00 00 01: a 4-byte big-endian unsigned N=1 with zero body bytes, which is the minimum positive value the quoted encoding admits and is one step away from N=0, whose injection already exists at g21-fixture-corpus.v7 as G21.cc5.length-prefix-0. Truncation therefore holds on the bytes themselves (0 body bytes is fewer than the 1 claimed) with no invented constant, and the draft states this without overreaching into oversize-from-prefix territory that the quoted preHandshake clause would not support.

The two-step pattern holds for a fourth time: D-348 recorded a first-authoring, D-350 recorded its per-platform copies, D-351's leftover-join measured that leftover-design stale, and D-352 now records the next first-authoring while explicitly deferring its own staleness measurement to a later leftover-join succeeding leftover-join.v28 of G21. The draft's Status disclaimer and Decision sentence say the same thing in both voices without either one drifting into the measurement.

The named open decision is carried with its cause, not as a bare label: 'Prefix exactly at the operative bound remains a named open decision' appears in both the environment recitation and the Subject, and the Decision separately refuses to first-author it and refuses to pin N=65536 as prefix-only RF-2. The subject's own remainderAfterThisCorpus and whatIsNotAuthored both retain the item, so the draft neither drops it nor settles it.

independentChecksBeyondDispatch.payloadByteLevelVerification: The 4 payload bytes were read as hex rather than trusted from the catalog: 00 00 00 01. Big-endian unsigned decode is 1. Body byte count is 0. Truncation therefore holds on the bytes, and the draft's 'N=1 prefix with no body' is a byte-level true statement rather than a restatement of the catalog's own prose.
independentChecksBeyondDispatch.minimumPositiveClaim: N=1 is the minimum positive value a 4-byte unsigned encoding admits, so the draft's 'quoting the minimum positive value of the control-protocol-contract.v2 4-byte unsigned encoding' is derivable from the quoted frame clause with no invented constant. It is also distinct from the already-authored N=0 injection G21.cc5.length-prefix-0.
independentChecksBeyondDispatch.prefixReuseCheck: The payload digest b40711a8... is distinct from the g21.v11, g21.v15 and g21.v20 payload digests recorded in the subject's recordedInputs, so the draft's three non-reuse disclaimers (16777216, 16777217, 4294967295) hold on bytes and not merely on assertion.

reviewSummary: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. D-352 records g21-fixture-corpus.v26 as a G21 leftover-design CC-5 truncated-body injection after D-351, and every load-bearing claim in it survives measurement against live bytes. All six cited digests recompute exactly. The payload is exactly 00 00 00 01 at 0444 in a directory with one file and no platform subdirectory, so the 4-byte big-endian unsigned N=1 with no body is a byte-level fact, its truncation holds (0 body bytes against 1 claimed), and N=1 is the minimum positive value the quoted frame encoding admits rather than an invented constant. The frame, preHandshake, postHandshake and CC-5 intent clauses are quoted verbatim from control-protocol-contract.v2, and 'truncated bodies' is genuinely named in the closed CC-5 intent, so class membership is quoted rather than argued. Both Stage A return shapes are recited member for member without flattening, including the Codex findingIdentifiersInvented flag that the D-350 entry omitted; CLAUDE-G21FXV26-A-1 is named three times with its four members, the Codex Identifiers cell reads 'none', and no observation identifier is invented for the eight unlabeled Claude observation strings. The three obligations that this entry must not touch stay untouched: leftover-design of OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING remains on leftover-join.v28 of G21 with reasons stated, this injection's own staleness is deferred by name to a later leftover-join succeeding leftover-join.v28 of G21, and leftover-join.v14 of sarif, g21-fixture-corpus.v25 and g21-fixture-corpus.v21 all keep their prior recordings. No lineage collapses: leftover-join.v26 of G21 is never mentioned and the different-lineages disclaimer appears twice. Custody holds -- HEAD unmoved, last heading D-351, COORD and file 08 at their dispatched digests, zero modified tracked files, required-now 28, DR-G21 OPEN, DR-107 and DR-118 unflattened, the no-cell-edit branch not spanning D-236, and docs/v2/implementation absent from disk. All 28 dispatched attacks were run, plus one added attack on g21-fixture-corpus.v21 remasurement, and none of the 29 landed. One advisory records that the Subject writes 'Fixture file remains at' for a directory that first exists in this cycle, where D-350 used the neutral 'live under' in the same slot; the claim is true of bytes, so it is drafting work and not a bar to recording.
